_note:
This is the game's DEFAULT style — the CAMERA, the RENDERING and the PALETTE, and nothing else. It is prepended to every art prompt for this game: room passes (.github/art/room.py), character rows (.github/art/generate_row.py) and the 'Generate game asset' Action all read it.

IT DOES NOT DESCRIBE THE ROOM PIPELINE, AND MUST NOT. That lives in docs/ROOM_ART_STANDARD.md and in the pass prompts under .github/art/room_prompts/, which are the single copy of the recipe. This file used to restate it — back when a room was TWO layers — and it drifted: long after the standard became THREE passes, this file was still telling the generator that a floor plate is 'a complete floor and its surrounding architecture', and that any door 'MUST be on the back-right wall'. Because styled() puts this text IN FRONT of the pass prompt, the stale copy won: the lounge's pass-2 plate came back as planks in a painted brown vignette instead of on flat white, which keys to nothing and makes the whole frame walkable. If a rule about how rooms are built belongs anywhere, it belongs in the pass prompt — point at it from here, never copy it.

HISTORY of the style itself, in one day: (1) close-up cinematic-portrait camera used for rooms by mistake — looked like a photo backdrop with cutouts standing in front; (2) fixed the camera but kept painterly/vignette rendering — still murky, user said 'think Stardew Valley'; (3) went fully flat cel-shaded Stardew — user said that 'doesn't fit the bill' and pointed back at the inspiration images and the already-generated portraits as the real target: richly saturated, moody, warm-vs-cool lit, textured.
camera:
Top-down RPG interior room view: a clean, gently-angled overhead perspective, orthogonal walls, a clearly readable floor plane. NEVER an eye-level photograph, NEVER a close-up character-portrait crop.

The prompt that follows says WHAT is being drawn — a whole composed scene, a bare walkable surface, a sheet of props, or a character. Follow it exactly, including what it says about the background: this paragraph fixes the camera and nothing else.
style: Detailed 16-bit pixel art matching this game's own established look (see reference/the-game/inspo-*.png and the character portraits already generated, e.g. michael.png, kat.png) — NOT Stardew Valley's flat cel-shading. Rich, saturated color with real depth: warm light sources (lanterns, windows, candles) casting an actual warm glow against cooler ambient walls/shadow, visible texture on surfaces (brick coursing, wood grain, fabric folds), confident dark outlines. Still requires clean, sharply readable orthogonal architecture — walls meet the floor at a clear line, furniture silhouettes are unambiguous — richness of color/lighting must never come at the cost of the room reading as a coherent walkable space. For a CHARACTER SPRITE: same rich rendering technique and palette as the portrait busts, at a small full-body top-down scale, head-to-feet, clean readable silhouette from the overhead angle.
palette: Saturated, warm-vs-cool contrast — warm amber/gold light pooling against cooler blue, indigo, or wood-brown ambient tone, matching the inspiration images (e.g. inspo-08's warm doorway/window glow against cool blue brick walls). Not evenly lit throughout — real light sources create real pools of brighter warm light against a moodier surrounding tone, as long as the overall room still reads clearly (no area so dark the architecture becomes ambiguous).
background: For a PROP SHEET or a SPRITE SHEET: every item isolated on FLAT PURE WHITE (#FFFFFF), uniform, hard-edged, with a wide white band between items and a generous white margin — never transparency, which comes back as a beige wash. For a single CHARACTER SPRITE: isolated on a transparent background, no scene/ground/shadow drawn in. For anything else, the prompt says.
constraints: No text, no logos, no watermark, no UI elements, no borders/frames or vignette baked into the image. STRICTLY no people, characters or figures anywhere in a room or on a prop sheet — a stray figure standing in the scene is a confirmed failure mode. Architecture must be clean and orthogonal — walls meet the floor at a clear, readable line — and rich atmospheric lighting/colour is expected and desired, not a flaw. A character sprite must be full body head-to-feet, standing, facing the viewer — never a close-up bust crop — and isolated ONLY on plain transparent background with no scene, room, walls, furniture or floor drawn in. Any character wearing glasses must have clearly visible human eyes — pupils and eye whites — showing behind the lenses, never blank/hidden skin tone.
characterSpecRule: EVERY character has an entry here, written BEFORE any of its art is generated, and the generators BUILD their prompt from it — nobody retypes a description. See .github/art/CHARACTER_SHEETS.md. `appears` is what makes checking possible: a material marked always must be visible in every frame of every sheet, while a conditional one may come and go. Add to a spec the moment a detail is caught drifting; that is the entire point of it.

nella.name: Nella (Infinity avatar)
nella.species: Nella's magical avatar inside Infinity. Plot: "It looked like I had transformed into a demon of some sort" — still recognisably herself, with horns, glowing red eyes and fangs added. Human build; the horns, eyes and fangs are the only changes.

horns.note: TWO short curved bright-red horns POKING THROUGH her black hair — plot: "a pair of bright red horns were poking through my black hair". They emerge from the hair, not from a bare forehead. Small: not antlers, not a crown.

hair.note: Very dark, thick, shoulder-length, slightly wild.

glasses.note: Round lenses. Hidden by her hair from directly behind, which is correct.

robe.note: Dark crimson hooded robe, falling to mid-calf.

bracelet.note: Copper band set with aquamarine gems — her rank. Copper is the LOWEST rank; it must never read as gold.

eyes.note: GLOWING RED eyes — plot: "my eyes were glowing red". Not merely red-tinted; they give off light.

fangs.appears: front views, when her mouth is open
fangs.note: Plot: "I had fangs." Small, not a monster's tusks.

nella.proportions: About four heads tall, head roughly a quarter of total height; a teenager, not a child.
neverDraw: horns larger than her own head

nella_human.name: Nella (real world)
nella_human.species: the same girl OUTSIDE Infinity, before the transformation — an ordinary human teenager in modern clothes. No magical features whatsoever.

hair.note: Dark brown, thick, shoulder-length. Same cut as her avatar, ordinary colour.

hoodie.note: Red zip-up hoodie — the everyday echo of the crimson robe.

nella_human.proportions: Identical build to her avatar — the same girl. About four heads tall.

kat.name: Kat
kat.species: A charming adult human MAN — plot: "a man I had never seen before who was wearing a black robe and a top hat. He had black hair, glasses, and a large smile", and he speaks "almost purring". Warm, theatrical, immediately disarming.

tophat.note: A BLACK TOP HAT, tall and flat-topped. It is her silhouette — never a cap, never bare-headed.

hair.note: Black, long, falling past the shoulders below the hat.

robe.note: Long black robe over a dark suit.

bracelet.note: GOLD band with emerald gems — a rank above Timothy's silver, below diamond.

kat.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall including the hat.
neverDraw: a short brimmed cap instead of a top hat

may.name: May 2000
may.species: a human champion duellist and idol — hostile, grieving, sharp-featured. Fully human.

hair.note: BRIGHT MAGENTA-PINK, shoulder length. Her single most identifying feature. NOTE FOR CUTTERS: this is the same colour family as the sheet's magenta gridlines — see WALK_SHEETS.md; cells are cut between the green gutters so the divider is never keyed by colour.

robe.note: Royal-blue open robe worn OVER the jacket.

jacket.note: Black leather jacket under the robe.

shirt.note: White pearled shirt, visible at the collar.

may.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.
neverDraw: animal ears or any animal feature

timothy.name: Timothy
timothy.species: an older, kindly human duellist — the highest-ranked of the group.

bracelet.note: ALL DIAMOND — the top rank. Bright, colourless, unmistakably not gold or silver.

timothy.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.
neverDraw: a coloured gem in the bracelet

rex.name: Rex
rex.species: a scruffy, weathered adult human man with a full beard. Grown and unkempt — never a smooth-faced youth.

beard.note: FULL red-brown beard and moustache. He is never clean-shaven.

robe.note: Deep-gold / mustard robe with a wide collar.

bracelet.note: COPPER band set with AMETHYSTS — the detail May is suspicious about. Copper with purple gems, never gold.

rex.proportions: An adult man, about four and a half heads tall, slightly hunched.

diamond.name: Diamond
diamond.species: a confident adult human woman, the self-declared star of Kat's table.

highlights.note: RAINBOW streaks through the black hair — her name detail. Not chroma-key spill; they are meant to be there.

diamond.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.

eric.name: Eric
eric.species: A cheerful adult human man — plot: "A young man with broad shoulders, blonde hair, and a gray robe", whose "laugh was comforting and warm".

robe.note: Grey-green robe over a plain shirt.

eric.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall, broad.

magma.name: Magma
magma.species: A shapeshifter — plot: "a short and very young woman... barely older than a child", and as Nella shakes her hand "her face shifted, features becoming a bit older, hair becoming longer. It was like she was Mystique from the X-Men". Draw her YOUNG form; the shifting is a story beat, not a sprite.

coat.note: Rust-orange coat — the ember in her name.

magma.proportions: Young — slighter and shorter than the adults, about four heads tall.

john.name: John Boxley
john.species: the trapped creator of Puzzle Attack — an exhausted, hunched older human man, almost entirely hidden inside a hooded robe.

robe.note: Heavy brown HOODED robe, hood always UP, falling to the floor. It is his whole silhouette.

hair.note: Brown, barely visible under the hood.

skin.note: Only the face inside the hood, in shadow. NOTE: his robe hides his feet entirely, which is why the stance check cannot read him.

john.proportions: An adult man, hunched — reads shorter than the others, about four heads tall.

michael.name: Michael
michael.species: an adult human detective who runs a jazz coffee shop in the Library. Warm, watchful.

robe.note: LIGHT-BLUE robe — his most identifying colour.

vest.note: Brown suit vest with GOLD BUTTONS over a white undershirt — plot's words, glimpsed when his robe slips off one shoulder.

badge.note: A badge glimpsed under the robe — Nella wonders if he is a police officer. It is deliberately hidden, so it is never drawn on a walk sheet.

michael.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.

kyran.name: Kyran
kyran.species: Infinity's head of research. Plot: "a man with dark hair and eyes who was wearing a lab coat and holding a tablet of some sort. He looked like a scientist", with a dazzling smile.

labcoat.note: WHITE LAB COAT, open. His silhouette — never a robe.

tablet.note: He carries a tablet in art of him at work; a walk sheet does not need it.

skin.note: Dark brown skin. This comes from the inspiration art (PLOT.md: "inspo: black scientist in the lab"), not from the plot text, which says only "dark hair and eyes" — recorded so nobody mistakes it for a licence to change him.

kyran.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.

chuck.name: Chuck
chuck.species: Nella's real-world best friend since high school; works at a lumberyard, drives a dark blue pickup. Plot: "He was a big guy, with dark curly hair and a large beard... Deep down, though, Chuck was a teddy bear." Imposing to a stranger, gentle in fact.

hair.note: DARK CURLY hair — plot's words. Not straight, not light brown, and he is not bald.

beard.note: A LARGE BEARD, not a moustache. The shipped art gives him a walrus moustache and no beard; the plot says beard, and the plot wins.

flannel.note: RED FLANNEL JACKET — plot: "He pulled a brown paper bag out from under his red flannel jacket". The teal-blue hoodie in the current art is not from the plot.

eyes.note: Deep blue — plot: "I looked up into his deep blue eyes".

chuck.proportions: A big man in his thirties — broader and taller than Nella, about four and a half heads tall.

devil.name: The Devil
devil.species: the mirror-popup host of Infinity — a smiling red-skinned devil. Charming rather than monstrous.

skin.note: Red skin — he is the only red-skinned character.

robe.note: Dark plum robe with crimson trim.

devil.proportions: An adult, about four and a half heads tall.
